```plato
// Lerp endpoints, now derived from Add + Between rather than written per type.
Law_LerpAtZeroIsStart2D(a: Point2D, b: Point2D): Boolean
    => a.Lerp(b, 0.0).Distance(a) <= 1e-4;
```

### Line 62

```plato

    // Linear interpolation of both parts; t is unclamped.
    Lerp(a: Complex, b: Complex, t: Number): Complex
        => (a.Real + (b.Real - a.Real) * t,
            a.Imaginary + (b.Imaginary - a.Imaginary) * t);
```

### Line 335

```plato

    //==
    // # Interpolation and limits

    // Linear interpolation of value and derivative alike; t is unclamped and
    // treated as a constant (its own derivative does not participate).
    Lerp(a: DualNumber, b: DualNumber, t: Number): DualNumber
        => (a.Value + (b.Value - a.Value) * t,
            a.Derivative + (b.Derivative - a.Derivative) * t);
```
